name: Dr. Vikram Sethi
subject: Cage Outer Ring Carbon Fiber Reinforcement & VTX Power Limits
message: Greetings Secretariat, our Class 20 striker drone utilizes a 0.8mm woven carbon-fiber inner truss to reinforce the polycarbonate outer cage. Can the technical scrutineering team confirm if this will pass the sphere weight ceiling (under 110g)? Also, are VTX power outputs restricted to 25mW or 200mW inside the indoor flight netting?

name: Ananya Deshmukh
subject: Outstation Contingent Hostel Accommodations for 6-Member Crew
message: Hello GDSL Organizers, our team "RV Aero Strikers" has registered for Class 20. We have 6 crew members (4 pilots + 2 ground pit crew) travelling from Bengaluru. Could you share details regarding on-campus hostel allotment, check-in dates prior to scrutineering, and shuttle transit from IGI Airport/New Delhi Railway Station?

name: Prof. Raghavendra Kulkarni
subject: Institutional Purchase Order & GST Invoice for Class 40 Registration Fee
message: Respected Committee, our institute's student affairs division is disbursing the registration fee of ₹3,000 for team "BITS Skypulse". We require an official Proforma Invoice with Galgotias University GSTIN and HSN code for our finance office to process the direct NEFT transfer. Please advise.
adminNotes: Proforma invoice draft sent to University Finance desk. Awaiting NEFT confirmation.

name: Kabir Malhotra
subject: Arena Floor Brand Activation & Flight Sim Booth Partnership
message: We would like to explore setting up an official energy drink pit stop station and 4-pod FPV drone simulator setup right beside the main GDSL flight cage during the finals on March 15. Please connect us with the corporate partnerships team.
adminNotes: Forwarded to Prof. Dean Partnerships. MoU agreed for 4 simulator pods in Zone B.
